φύγῃ: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. subj. 3 sg. act. (with κε): ’may escape’
φύτευεν: φυτεύω — plant, sow; devise; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφύτευε), ν-movable

ἄχνυται: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, be distressed; pres. 3 sg. mid.

__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’)
__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’)
__broaden__.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
__broaden__.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’
__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’)
__broaden__.ὄληται: ὄλλυμαι — perish, be lost, be destroyed; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (μή + subj.: ’lest … perish’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’when … perishes’ (ἐπὴν … ὄληται) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὅπως: ’so that … may perish’
__broaden__.δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg. (purpose): ’might give’ · also continuing a wish after εἴ πως, with a new subject: ’and might (she) grant’ (δοίη δέ μοι εὖχος Ἀθήνη ’and might Athena grant me glory’) · also in a main-clause wish: ’may (Zeus) give’ (Ζεύς τοι δοίη ’may Zeus give you’) · also opt. in a protasis after εἴ: ’if (someone) should give’ (εἴ τίς τοι … εἵματα δοίη ’if someone were to give you clothing’)
__broaden__.εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’)
__broaden__.ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv. · also ’idly, to no purpose, without ground’ (ἄλλως … ψεύδοντ’ ’tell lies idly’)
__broaden__.ἄλλοθ: ἄλλοτε — at another time, elsewhere, ever again; adv., elided (ἄλλοθ’ = ἄλλοτε) · also ἄλλοθι — elsewhere, in another place; adv., elided (ἄλλοθ’ ὄληται ’perishes elsewhere, far away’)
__broaden__.ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’) · also + subj. without κε, in a general clause: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε τις μνήσῃ ’whenever anyone mentions’)
__broaden__.μνήσῃ: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); aor. subj. 2 sg. mid. (= Attic μνησθῇς), after ἵνα: ’you may remember’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. (with τις), ’mention, make mention of’ + gen. (τις μνήσῃ κεδνοῖο ἄνακτος ’someone mentions my careful lord’)
__broaden__.ἔφην: φημί — say, declare; impf. 1 sg., augmented, ἐ- before the consonant-initial stem φη-: ’I said’ · also ’I thought, supposed’, + fut. inf. (ἔφην ἔσσεσθαι ’I supposed he would be’)
__broaden__.κήδε: κῆδος — care, sorrow, trouble; neut. acc. pl., elided (κήδε’ = κήδεα, uncontracted; Attic κήδη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject (κήδε’ … τετεύχαται ’sorrows have been made ready’)
__broaden__.ἤπιον: ἤπιος — gentle, kind, mild; masc. acc. sg., predicate with an infinitive: ’kind (to you)’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with ἄνακτα: ’so kind a master’
__broaden__.ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. nom. sg., with οὔρεϊ: ’equal to a mountain’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’equally, as much as’ (ἶσον Ἀχιλλῆος … ἀχνύμεθα ’we grieve as much as for Achilles’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τόν, + dat.: ’like, equal to’ (ἔρνεϊ ἶσον ’like a sapling’)
__broaden__.ἔτρεφον: τρέφω — nurture, rear, feed; impf. 1 sg.: ’I nurtured, I fed’ · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they reared’ (μ’ ἔτρεφον αὐτοί ’they themselves reared me’)
__broaden__.πῖνε: πίνω — drink; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’was drinking, drank’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’drink!’ (πῖνε, καὶ ἄλλα … μεμνώμεθα ’drink, and let us remember other things’)
__broaden__.σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
__broaden__.παρὲξ: παρέξ — beside, past, beyond; adv./prep. + acc., here adverbial with εἴποιμι: ’say otherwise, speak beside the point’ · also adv. with ἐλάσωσιν, ’past, beyond’ (τάς γε παρὲξ ἐλάσωσιν ’drive past them’) · also prep. + acc.: ’past, beyond’ (παρὲξ τὴν νῆσον ἐλαύνετε ’drive past the island’) · also adv., ’aside, apart, besides’ (ἄλλα παρὲξ μεμνώμεθα ’let us remember other things apart from this’)
__broaden__.κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’)
